import numpy as np
def norm(pts):
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    return sorted((r-min(rs),c-min(cs)) for r,c in pts)
def dihed(S):
    out=set(); cur=list(S)
    for _ in range(4):
        for f in (lambda x:x, lambda x:[r[::-1] for r in x], lambda x:[r for r in x][::-1], None):
            a=f(cur) if f is not None else cur
            out.add(tuple(norm(a)))
        cur=[list(r) for r in zip(*cur)]
    return out
for gi,go in [(d1i,d1o),(d2i,d2o)]:
    fr,fc=windows(gi); lc=int(gi[fr[0]][0])
    colors=sorted(set(int(v) for v in np.unique(gi.tolist())))
    colors.remove(lc); colors=sorted(set(colors)-{0})
    tm=None
    for ri in range(len(fr)-1):
        for ci in range(len(fc)-1):
            r0,r1=fr[ri]+1,fr[ri+1]; c0,c1=fc[ci]+1,fc[ci+1]
            if set(np.unique(gi[r0:r1,c0:c1]))-{0,lc}: continue
            m=np.argwhere(go[r0:r1,c0:c1]!=0)
            rs=[p[0] for p in m]; cs=[p[1] for p in m]
            tm=norm(list(m)); break

import numpy as np
def solve(gi):
    g=np.array(gi); h,w=g.shape
    lc=int(np.unique(g.flat)[np.isin(g.flat,[0]).sum()]) if False else None
    # line color: most common nonzero value that forms a full row or col
    vals=set(int(x) for x in g.flat)-{0}
    lc=max(vals,key=lambda v:int(np.sum((g==v).any(1)))+int(np.sum((g==v).any(0))))
    fr=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==lc for v in g[r])]
    fc=[c for c in range(w) if all(v==lc for v in g[:,c])]
    div_r=sorted(fr+[h-1]); div_c=sorted(fc+[w-1])
    # bands: split at dividers, taking care dividers separate; last band goes to h-1 (already), use boundaries
    rb=[-1]+fr+[-1]; cb=[-1]+fc+[-1]
    out=g.copy()
    from collections import deque
    seen=np.zeros((h,w),bool)
    best=None
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r,c]!=0 and g[r,c]!=lc and not seen[r,c]:
                q=deque([(r,c)]); comp=[]; seen[r,c]=True
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and g[ny,nx]==g[r,c] and not seen[ny,nx]:
                            seen[ny,nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
                if best is None or len(comp)>len(best): best=comp
    rs=[p[0] for p in best]; cs=[p[1] for p in best]
    tmpl=sorted((r-min(rs),c-min(cs)) for r,c in best)
    def bcolor(r0,r1,c0,c1):
        vals=[int(x) for x in g[r0:r1,c0:c1].flat if x not in (0,lc)]
        return max(set(vals),key=vals.count) if vals else None
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            r0,r1=rb[ri]+1,rb[ri+1]; c0,c1=cb[ci]+1,cb[ci+1]
            bc=bcolor(r0,r1,c0,c1)
            if bc is None: continue
            for rr,cc in tmpl:
                if 0<=r0+rr<h and 0<=c0+cc<w: out[r0+rr,c0+cc]=bc
    return out.tolist()

import numpy as np, json
from collections import deque
def norm(pts):
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    return sorted((r-min(rs),c-min(cs)) for r,c in pts)
def components(g, lc):
    h,w=g.shape; seen=np.zeros((h,w),bool); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r,c]!=0 and g[r,c]!=lc and not seen[r,c]:
                q=deque([(r,c)]); comp=[]; seen[r,c]=True
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and g[ny,nx]==g[r,c] and not seen[ny,nx]:
                            seen[ny,nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append(comp)
    return comps
def solve(gi):
    g=np.array(gi); h,w=g.shape
    fr=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(int(x) for x in g[r]))==1]
    fc=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(int(x) for x in g[:,c]))==1]
    lc=int(g[fr[0]][0])
    rb=[-1]+sorted(fr)+[-1]; cb=[-1]+sorted(fc)+[-1]
    # template = largest non-line connected component
    comps=components(g,lc)
    best=max(comps,key=len)
    tmpl=norm(best)
    out=g.copy()
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            r0,r1=rb[ri]+1,rb[ri+1]; c0,c1=cb[ci]+1,cb[ci+1]
            bc=max(set(int(x) for x in g[r0:r1,c0:c1].flat-{0,lc}),key=lambda v:(g[r0:r1,c0:c1]==v).sum()) if any(v in set(int(x) for x in g[r0:r1,c0:c1].flat-{0,lc}) for v in [1,2,3,4,6,7]) else None
            # band color: majority nonzero non-line value in window
            vals=[int(x) for x in g[r0:r1,c0:c1].flat if x not in (0,lc)]
            if not vals: continue
            bc=max(set(vals),key=vals.count)
            if bc==0: continue
            for rr,cc in tmpl:
                y,x=r0+rr,c0+cc
                if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w: out[y,x]=bc
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:

    o=solve(gi)
    dd=np.argwhere(o!=go)
    print(name,'ok' if not len(dd) else f'{len(dd)} diffs', dd[:10].tolist())

from collections import deque,Counter
def f(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1]
    Rb=[-1]+sr+[h]; Cb=[-1]+sc+[w]
    out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    for i in range(len(Rb)-1):
        r0,r1=Rb[i],Rb[i+1]
        best=None; tmpl=None
        for j in range(len(Cb)-1):
            c0,c1=Cb[j],Cb[j+1]
            blk=[[g[a][b] for b in range(c0,c1)] for a in range(r0,r1)]
            cnt=Counter(x for row in blk for x in row)
            bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
            seen=[[False]*len(blk[0]) for _ in range(len(blk))]
            for a in range(len(blk)):
                for b in range(len(blk[0])):
                    if blk[a][b]!=bg and not seen[a][b]:
                        q=deque([(a,b)]); seen[a][b]=True; cells=[]
                        while q:
                            x,y=q.popleft(); cells.append((x,y))
                            for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                                xx,yy=x+dx,y+dy
                                if 0<=xx<len(blk) and 0<=yy<len(blk[0]) and blk[xx][yy]!=bg and not seen[xx][yy]:
                                    seen[xx][yy]=True; q.append((xx,yy))
                        if best is None or len(cells)>len(best):
                            best=cells
        # recompute colors per block
        for j in range(len(Cb)-1):
            c0,c1=Cb[j],Cb[j+1]
            blk=[[g[a][b] for b in range(c0,c1)] for a in range(r0,r1)]
            cnt=Counter(x for row in blk for x in row)
            bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
            sh=[(a,b) for a in range(len(blk)) for b in range(len(blk[0])) if blk[a][b]!=bg]
            sm=min(sh)
            col=blk[sm[0]][sm[1]]
            a0=min(a for a,_ in best); b0=min(b for _,b in best)
            for a in range(r0,r1):
                for b in range(c0,c1):
                    if (a-a0,b-b0) in set(best): out[a][b]=col
    return out

from collections import deque,Counter
def getbands(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1]
    return sr,sc,[ -1]+sr+[h],[-1]+sc+[w]
def comps(blk,bg):
    H,W=len(blk),len(blk[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for a in range(H):
        for b in range(W):
            if blk[a][b]!=bg and not seen[a][b]:
                q=deque([(a,b)]); seen[a][b]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    x,y=q.popleft(); cells.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        xx,yy=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=xx<H and 0<=yy<W and blk[xx][yy]!=bg and not seen[xx][yy]:
                            seen[xx][yy]=True; q.append((xx,yy))
                out.append((len(cells),blk[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]],cells))
    return out
def f(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    sr,sc,Rb,Cb=getbands(g)
    blks=[]
    for i in range(len(Rb)-1):
        band=[]
        for j in range(len(Cb)-1):
            c0=Cb[j]+1; c1=Cb[j+1]; r0=Rb[i]+1; r1=Rb[i+1]

            bg=Counter(x for row in blk for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
            cs=comps(blk,bg)
            band.append([{'size':s,'col':col,'cells':cells} for s,col,cells in cs],r0,c0)

        blks.append(('band',i)+tuple(row) for row in [None] )   # placeholder to rebuild later
